This tutorial follows the same complete workflow as the road examples, with OD-specific tables and interpretation:

**understand the source → inspect and validate trip records → construct `standard` from `nodes + od` → visualize a directed OD window → validate → export and read back.**

Unlike a road-flow example, Divvy has station nodes and directed origin–destination records. Curved arrows connect endpoints for display; they are not observed travel paths.

## Data, source, and preparation goal

This case uses station-to-station bicycle departures on **1 January 2026** from Divvy's January trip archive (`202601-trip-excerpt.csv`). The daily slice retains all 13 original columns and 1,950 departure records. The raw archive excerpt also includes one record from 2 January 2026 to demonstrate date filtering.

Each retained record represents **one individual departure** (`flow = 1` in `trips`) with timestamps recorded in the `America/Chicago` timezone. Station coordinates are derived as the median of valid paired source coordinates per station on the selected day, and arrows represent directed station pairs rather than physical street trajectories.

```{r source-summary, echo=FALSE}
original_sources <- read.csv("data/original-sources.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
knitr::kable(
  original_sources[c("file", "provider", "role")],
  caption = "Original data sources",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)

full_input <- readRDS(prepared_file)
audit <- full_input$provenance
excluded_total <- sum(
  audit$missing_origin_only,
  audit$missing_destination_only,
  audit$missing_both,
  audit$unmatched_coordinates
)
within_station_total <- sum(
  full_input$od$flow[full_input$od$origin_id == full_input$od$destination_id]
)

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Item = c(
      "Source departures on selected day",
      "Located stations (nodes)",
      "Retained station-to-station trips (OD rows)",
      "Within-station trips",
      "Excluded records (missing station ID or coordinates)",
      "Timezone",
      "OD unit"
    ),
    Value = c(
      audit$source_departures,
      nrow(full_input$nodes),
      nrow(full_input$od),
      within_station_total,
      excluded_total,
      full_input$timezone,
      full_input$od_unit
    )
  ),
  caption = "Complete prepared dataset",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

Departure clocks retain fractional seconds in `America/Chicago`. Omitted station pairs or timestamps are not filled with zero because a complete dyad-observation domain is not assumed.

The preparation goal is to filter the declared departure day, validate unique ride IDs and local clocks, construct a located station register, retain only trips whose two endpoints join that register, preserve within-station rides, optionally aggregate time or space without changing the trip total, and draw a descriptive directed OD map.

## Raw input, field meanings, and editable configuration

### Configuration to edit

```{r configuration}
raw_file <- "data/raw/202601-trip-excerpt.csv"
prepared_file <- "data/input.rds"
day <- "2026-01-01"
timezone <- "America/Chicago"
window <- c("00:00", "03:00")
hourly_seconds <- 3600L
aggregation_radius_m <- 1000

divvy_fields <- c(
  ride = "ride_id",
  departure = "started_at",
  origin = "start_station_id",
  destination = "end_station_id",
  origin_name = "start_station_name",
  destination_name = "end_station_name",
  origin_lat = "start_lat",
  origin_lon = "start_lng",
  destination_lat = "end_lat",
  destination_lon = "end_lng"
)
```

The mapping identifies source roles explicitly. `timezone` controls parsing of local clocks; `window` is a half-open visualization interval; and `aggregation_radius_m` changes the node definition, so it must be reported with any grouped result.

### Inspect the raw trip excerpt

The source reader filters the archive excerpt to departures on `2026-01-01` and strips trailing ASCII spaces from the two station-name columns while keeping all other source values unchanged.

```{r read-raw}
original_day <- read_divvy_source(raw_file, day = day, fields = divvy_fields)
raw <- clean_divvy_station_names(original_day, divvy_fields)
head(raw[c("ride_id", "started_at", "start_station_id", "end_station_id", "start_lat", "start_lng")])
```

```{r raw-field-description, echo=FALSE}
raw_dictionary <- data.frame(
  Source_field = c(
    "ride_id",
    "started_at, ended_at",
    "start_station_id, end_station_id",

  ),

```

The preprocessing also records how many rows are selected by date and how many station-name entries had trailing spaces removed.

```{r source-rows-2, echo=TRUE}
original_day <- read_divvy_source(raw_file, day = day, fields = divvy_fields)
```

```{r source-rows-4, echo=TRUE}
raw <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(day_file, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "", showProgress = FALSE))
```

```{r source-rows-5, echo=FALSE}
expected_day <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(day_reference, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "",
    showProgress = FALSE))
stopifnot(identical(raw, cleaned_day), identical(raw, expected_day), identical(raw[unchanged_fields],
    original_day[unchanged_fields]), nrow(raw) == 1950L, ncol(raw) == 13L)
knitr::kable(data.frame(stage = c("Original archive excerpt", "Selected departure day", "Other source date"),
    rows = c(nrow(archive), nrow(raw), nrow(archive) - nrow(raw))), caption = "Date selection before station or OD processing", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(head(raw[c("ride_id", "started_at", "start_station_id", "end_station_id", "start_lat", "start_lng")]),
    caption = "Day CSV read back with all original columns retained", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```


The new day CSV retains all 13 columns and 1,950 records. Trailing spaces change 13 departure-name values and 11 arrival-name values. Every other field and the typed CSV readback are checked against the original selected rows; supplied files remain unchanged.

### Deliberately invalid input and correction

Each retained ride ID must be unique. The following in-memory copy repeats the first ride ID but changes a non-mapped descriptive field, so it is not an exact duplicate and must be rejected. The source CSV is unchanged.

```{r invalid-input}
bad_raw <- rbind(raw, raw[1, ])
bad_raw$member_casual[nrow(bad_raw)] <- paste0(bad_raw$member_casual[nrow(bad_raw)], "_duplicate")
cat(tryCatch(
  {
    ride_input(
      bad_raw,
      day = day,
      timezone = timezone,
      fields = divvy_fields
    )
    "No error was raised."
  },
  error = conditionMessage
))
```

The corrected input is the cleaned, date-filtered `raw` table. Records lacking an identified and located origin or destination are excluded with explicit reason counts; they are not converted into zero-flow dyads.

```{r corrected-input-check}
corrected_input <- ride_input(
  raw,
  day = day,
  timezone = timezone,
  fields = divvy_fields
)
data.frame(
  source_departures = corrected_input$provenance$source_departures,
  retained_trips = corrected_input$provenance$retained_trips,
  unique_ride_ids = !anyDuplicated(corrected_input$od$ride_id),
  endpoint_references_valid = all(
    corrected_input$od$origin_id %in% corrected_input$nodes$node_id &
      corrected_input$od$destination_id %in% corrected_input$nodes$node_id
  )
)
```

## Convert with the general bdynets interface

Raw trip files vary across bike-share and transit providers, so the source-specific helper `ride_input()` is used as an adapter to reconcile station coordinates, filter incomplete records, and produce the canonical `nodes` and `od` tables expected by the package.

### Prepare canonical `nodes` and `od` tables

```{r prepare-canonical-tables}
adapter_output <- ride_input(
  raw,
  day = day,
  timezone = timezone,
  fields = divvy_fields
)

nodes <- adapter_output[["nodes"]]
od <- adapter_output[["od"]]
```

Once the canonical `nodes` and `od` tables exist, the public constructor call is the same for Divvy and for any other OD dataset:

### Construct `standard` with `traffic_input()`

```{r construct-standard-input}
standard <- bdynets::traffic_input(
  nodes = nodes,
  od = od,
  timezone = timezone,
  od_time_kind = adapter_output[["od_time_kind"]],
  provenance = adapter_output[["provenance"]],
  title = "Divvy station departures",
  description = "Individual directed station-to-station departures on the selected source day.",
  preparation = c(
    "Filter the declared local departure day and validate unique ride IDs.",
    "Build station coordinates from medians of valid paired endpoint coordinates.",
    "Retain trips only when both station IDs join the located node register.",
    "Keep within-station rides in OD totals while excluding them from arrow drawing."
  )
)
```

The returned object is a named list with schema `bdynets-traffic-input-v1`. Its complete top-level structure is shown below; optional road and event components that do not apply to this OD example are retained as `NULL`.

### What does `standard` contain?

```{r standard-structure}
str(standard, max.level = 1, give.attr = FALSE)
```

The two main tables in the result are `nodes` and `od`.

```{r show-standard, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  head(standard$nodes),
  caption = "Standard station nodes table (first six rows)",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  head(standard$od),
  caption = "Standard individual OD table (first six rows)",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

The source-specific preprocessing makes the first three changes below; the general `traffic_input()` constructor validates and records the resulting tables and metadata:

- **Station register (`nodes`):** 512 located stations receive unique `node_id` values, zero-based `node_idx` indices, representative `display_name` labels, and median `longitude`/`latitude` coordinates;
- **Trip reconciliation (`od`):** 720 departures missing an origin ID (186), destination ID (288), or both (246) are excluded and logged in provenance, leaving 1,230 complete station-to-station departures (including 85 within-station rides);
- **Time and flow:** each departure timestamp is parsed in `America/Chicago` (`od_time_kind = "instant"`) with `flow = 1` trip per ride;
- **Metadata:** coordinate reference system, timezone, OD unit, and reconciliation provenance are retained in the standard object.

There is no explicit table of every possible station pair at every instant. Therefore, an absent OD record means **not supplied**, not an observed zero. A zero can only be claimed when the eligible dyad and observation interval have been defined and observed completely.

```{r standard-metadata, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Field = c("schema", "crs", "timezone", "od_time_kind", "od_unit"),
    Value = c(
      standard$schema,
      standard$crs,
      standard$timezone,
      standard$od_time_kind,
      standard$od_unit
    )
  ),
  caption = "Key standard-object metadata",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Adapt a CSV with renamed columns

Another provider can use different headers as long as the user maps the same required roles.

```{r renamed-csv}
incoming <- raw
incoming_fields <- c(
  ride = "trip_key",
  departure = "departure_local",
  origin = "from_station",
  destination = "to_station",
  origin_name = "from_name",
  destination_name = "to_name",
  origin_lat = "from_latitude",
  origin_lon = "from_longitude",
  destination_lat = "to_latitude",
  destination_lon = "to_longitude"
)
names(incoming)[match(unname(divvy_fields), names(incoming))] <- unname(incoming_fields)

mapped_input <- ride_input(
  incoming,
  day = day,
  timezone = timezone,
  fields = incoming_fields
)
stopifnot(
  identical(mapped_input$nodes, standard$nodes),
  identical(mapped_input$od, standard$od)
)
head(incoming[unname(incoming_fields[c("ride", "departure", "origin", "destination")])])
```

Only the mapping changes; ride identity, timestamps, endpoints, missingness, units, and the general constructor do not.

### Optional temporal and spatial OD aggregation

When coarse temporal or spatial resolution is needed, the same retained departures can be aggregated into hourly station intervals (`bin_seconds = 3600L`) or grouped spatially within a target radius (`aggregate_od_data()`) and wrapped with `bdynets::traffic_input()`:

```{r derived-od}
hourly_input <- ride_input(
  raw,
  day = day,
  timezone = timezone,
  bin_seconds = hourly_seconds,
  fields = divvy_fields
)

aggregation <- aggregate_od_data(
  nodes = standard$nodes,
  flows = standard$od,
  radius_m = aggregation_radius_m,
  node_columns = c(
    id = "node_id",
    longitude = "longitude",
    latitude = "latitude",
    name = "display_name",
    weight = NA_character_
  ),
  flow_columns = c(
    origin = "origin_id",
    destination = "destination_id",
    count = "flow",
    time = "time"
  ),
  timezone = timezone
)

spatial_membership <- as.data.frame(aggregation$membership)

spatial_input <- bdynets::traffic_input(
  nodes = as.data.frame(aggregation$nodes),
  od = as.data.frame(aggregation$flows),
  timezone = timezone,
  od_time_kind = standard$od_time_kind,
  provenance = list(
    station_preparation = standard$provenance,
    spatial_aggregation = c(aggregation$metadata, list(membership = spatial_membership))
  )
)
```

#### Hourly station OD {.unnumbered}

Hourly station OD sums the retained departures by local hour, origin and destination. Intervals are half-open, `[start, start + 3600 seconds)`, in `America/Chicago`. Time selection chooses existing observations; aggregation constructs a different table.

```{r hourly-checks, echo=FALSE}
hourly_input$provenance$time_aggregation <- list(
  method = 'Sum of retained departures by local hour and directed station pair.',
  interval_seconds = hourly_seconds, boundary = '[start, start + interval_seconds)',
  source_date = day, timezone = timezone)
source_hour <- format(standard$od$time, '%Y-%m-%d %H', tz = timezone)
hour_counts <- aggregate(list(flow = standard$od$flow),
  list(hour = source_hour, origin_id = standard$od$origin_id,
       destination_id = standard$od$destination_id), sum)
expected_hour_counts <- setNames(hour_counts$flow,
  paste(hour_counts$hour, hour_counts$origin_id, hour_counts$destination_id))
actual_hour_counts <- setNames(hourly_input$od$flow,
  paste(format(hourly_input$od$time, '%Y-%m-%d %H', tz = timezone),
        hourly_input$od$origin_id, hourly_input$od$destination_id))
stopifnot(identical(hourly_input$nodes, standard$nodes),
  setequal(names(expected_hour_counts), names(actual_hour_counts)),
  all(expected_hour_counts[names(actual_hour_counts)] == actual_hour_counts),
  sum(hourly_input$od$flow) == sum(standard$od$flow),
  hourly_input$od_time_kind == 'interval_start',
  hourly_input$od_interval_seconds == hourly_seconds,
  all(format(hourly_input$od$time, '%M:%S', tz = timezone) == '00:00'),
  !anyDuplicated(hourly_input$od[c('time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id')]))
example_row <- if (any(hourly_input$od$flow > 1)) which(hourly_input$od$flow > 1)[1] else 1L
hour_example <- hourly_input$od[example_row, c('time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id', 'flow')]
example_start <- as.numeric(hour_example$time)
selected_departures <- standard$od$origin_id == hour_example$origin_id &
  standard$od$destination_id == hour_example$destination_id &
  as.numeric(standard$od$time) >= example_start &
  as.numeric(standard$od$time) < example_start + hourly_seconds
trip_example <- standard$od[selected_departures,
  c('ride_id', 'time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id', 'flow')]
stopifnot(sum(trip_example$flow) == hour_example$flow)
trip_display <- trip_example
trip_display$time <- format(trip_display$time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS6', tz = timezone)
knitr::kable(trip_display, caption = 'Departures contributing to one hourly OD record',
             format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(hour_example, caption = 'The corresponding hourly OD record',
             format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  representation = c('Individual departures', 'Hourly station OD'),
  nodes = c(nrow(standard$nodes), nrow(hourly_input$nodes)),
  records = c(nrow(standard$od), nrow(hourly_input$od)),
  trips = c(sum(standard$od$flow), sum(hourly_input$od$flow)),
  within_station_trips = c(sum(standard$od$flow[standard$od$origin_id == standard$od$destination_id]),
    sum(hourly_input$od$flow[hourly_input$od$origin_id == hourly_input$od$destination_id]))),
  caption = 'Time aggregation on the same retained departure day', format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
```


The hourly table has `r nrow(hourly_input$od)` records for `r sum(hourly_input$od$flow)` trips. Each record is an interval count; it no longer represents one ride or carries a single `ride_id`. Original ride IDs remain in the day CSV. Station IDs and the `r nrow(hourly_input$nodes)` station locations are unchanged. Absent hours or pairs are not filled with zero because source completeness and the complete dyad-observation domain are not established.

The date remains part of each hourly timestamp. Pooling clock hours across dates would combine different dates and is a separate operation; the one-day example does not perform it.


#### Spatially grouped OD {.unnumbered}

The spatial example starts independently from the individual station departures. `aggregation_radius_m=1000` defines a 1000 metre station-to-representative distance bound. Its radius-cover method chooses representatives by endpoint activity and assigns stations to their nearest representative. The distance bound applies to a station and its representative, rather than every pair of stations within a group. Each group uses its representative station's existing coordinates.

```{r spatial-checks, echo=FALSE}
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(spatial_membership$raw_node_id),
  setequal(spatial_membership$raw_node_id, standard$nodes$node_id),
  all(spatial_membership$aggregate_node_id %in% spatial_input$nodes$node_id),
  all(spatial_membership$distance_to_representative_m <= aggregation_radius_m + 0.0005),
  aggregation$metadata$max_assignment_distance_m <= aggregation_radius_m + 1e-7,
  sum(spatial_input$nodes$raw_node_count) == nrow(standard$nodes),
  sum(spatial_input$od$flow) == sum(standard$od$flow),
  spatial_input$od_time_kind == standard$od_time_kind,
  is.null(spatial_input$od_interval_seconds))
member_map <- setNames(spatial_membership$aggregate_node_id, spatial_membership$raw_node_id)
expected_spatial <- aggregate(list(flow = standard$od$flow),
  list(time = as.numeric(standard$od$time),
       origin_id = unname(member_map[standard$od$origin_id]),
       destination_id = unname(member_map[standard$od$destination_id])), sum)
expected_spatial_counts <- setNames(expected_spatial$flow,
  paste(sprintf('%.17g', expected_spatial$time), expected_spatial$origin_id, expected_spatial$destination_id))
actual_spatial_counts <- setNames(spatial_input$od$flow,
  paste(sprintf('%.17g', as.numeric(spatial_input$od$time)), spatial_input$od$origin_id, spatial_input$od$destination_id))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(names(expected_spatial_counts)), !anyDuplicated(names(actual_spatial_counts)),
  setequal(names(expected_spatial_counts), names(actual_spatial_counts)),
  all(expected_spatial_counts[names(actual_spatial_counts)] == actual_spatial_counts))
source_loops <- sum(standard$od$flow[standard$od$origin_id == standard$od$destination_id])
spatial_loops <- sum(spatial_input$od$flow[spatial_input$od$origin_id == spatial_input$od$destination_id])
stopifnot(spatial_loops >= source_loops)
knitr::kable(head(spatial_membership), caption = 'Source stations and their representative groups',
             format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  representation = c('Individual stations', paste(aggregation_radius_m, 'm radius groups')),
  nodes = c(nrow(standard$nodes), nrow(spatial_input$nodes)),
  records = c(nrow(standard$od), nrow(spatial_input$od)),
  directed_pairs = c(nrow(unique(standard$od[c('origin_id', 'destination_id')])),
                     nrow(unique(spatial_input$od[c('origin_id', 'destination_id')]))),
  trips = c(sum(standard$od$flow), sum(spatial_input$od$flow)),
  within_node_trips = c(source_loops, spatial_loops)),
  caption = 'Spatial grouping on the same retained departure day', format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
```


The `r nrow(standard$nodes)` stations form `r nrow(spatial_input$nodes)` groups. Total trips remain `r sum(spatial_input$od$flow)`. Within-node trips increase from `r source_loops` to `r spatial_loops` because some trips between different source stations become trips within one group. Departure instants are retained; only records with the same instant and grouped directed pair are summed. No time aggregation is applied to this branch.

`raw_node_count` counts member stations, `member_weight` sums their unit station weights, and `endpoint_activity` counts departures plus arrivals at member stations. A within-node trip contributes two endpoints. Group IDs are representative source station IDs; `spatial_membership` retains every station's assignment and distance. A different radius defines different groups and within-group totals.

```{r show-derived-summary, echo=FALSE}
derived_summary <- data.frame(
  Representation = c(
    "Individual station departures",
    "Hourly station OD (3,600 s)",
    "Spatially grouped OD (1,000 m radius)"
  ),
  Nodes = c(
    nrow(standard$nodes),
    nrow(hourly_input$nodes),
    nrow(spatial_input$nodes)
  ),
  OD_records = c(
    nrow(standard$od),
    nrow(hourly_input$od),
    nrow(spatial_input$od)
  ),
  Total_trips = c(
    sum(standard$od$flow),
    sum(hourly_input$od$flow),
    sum(spatial_input$od$flow)
  ),
  Within_node_trips = c(
    sum(standard$od$flow[standard$od$origin_id == standard$od$destination_id]),
    sum(hourly_input$od$flow[hourly_input$od$origin_id == hourly_input$od$destination_id]),
    sum(spatial_input$od$flow[spatial_input$od$origin_id == spatial_input$od$destination_id])
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(derived_summary) <- c("Representation", "Nodes", "OD records", "Total trips", "Within-node trips")
knitr::kable(derived_summary, caption = "Comparison of primary and aggregated OD representations", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

<div class="note"><code>bdynets::traffic_input()</code> is the public, general constructor. Whether OD records represent individual trip instants, hourly station totals, or spatially grouped clusters, they use the same constructor and schema after producing canonical <code>nodes</code> and <code>od</code> tables.</div>

## Aggregate stations for display and call `traffic_map()`

The complete prepared day is stored in `data/input.rds`. The original station-level object remains the validated and exported source representation. For this map only, nearby stations are grouped within a **1.5 km radius** before OD pairs are counted. This reduces the number of single-trip green arrows without changing the retained trip total.

```{r plot-prepare}
day_standard <- readRDS(prepared_file)
limits <- as.POSIXct(paste(day, window), tz = timezone)

# Display helper: aggregate station nodes and remap every OD endpoint to a
# 1.5 km spatial group. The original station-level standard object is unchanged.
aggregate_od_for_map <- function(input, radius_m = 1500) {
  grouped <- aggregate_od_data(
    nodes = input$nodes,
    flows = input$od,
    radius_m = radius_m,
    node_columns = c(
      id = "node_id",
      longitude = "longitude",
      latitude = "latitude",
      name = "display_name",
      weight = NA_character_
    ),
    flow_columns = c(
      origin = "origin_id",
      destination = "destination_id",
      count = "flow",
      time = "time"
    ),
    timezone = input$timezone
  )

  bdynets::traffic_input(
    nodes = as.data.frame(grouped$nodes),
    od = as.data.frame(grouped$flows),
    timezone = input$timezone,
    od_time_kind = input$od_time_kind,
    provenance = list(
      station_level_source = input$provenance,
      display_aggregation = grouped$metadata,
      display_radius_m = radius_m
    ),
    title = paste0(input$title, " (", radius_m / 1000, " km groups)"),
    description = paste0(
      "Display-only OD aggregation of station nodes within ",
      radius_m / 1000, " km."
    )
  )
}

map_radius_m <- 1500
map_standard <- aggregate_od_for_map(day_standard, radius_m = map_radius_m)

# Use the grouped endpoints to define a stable viewport with extra breathing room.
# Supplying the same bounds to the on-screen and exported maps keeps all nodes,
# curved arrows, the legend, and the north arrow inside the map panel.
map_selection <- traffic_map(
  map_standard,
  start_time = limits[1],
  end_time = limits[2],
  basemap = NULL,
  draw = FALSE
)
map_longitude_range <- range(map_selection$nodes$longitude)
map_latitude_range <- range(map_selection$nodes$latitude)
map_longitude_span <- max(diff(map_longitude_range), 1e-6)
map_latitude_span <- max(diff(map_latitude_range), 1e-6)
map_bounds <- c(
  map_longitude_range[1] - 0.08 * map_longitude_span,
  map_longitude_range[2] + 0.08 * map_longitude_span,
  map_latitude_range[1] - 0.08 * map_latitude_span,
  map_latitude_range[2] + 0.08 * map_latitude_span
)

# Load the existing Chicago cache with the original station-window bounds.
# The broader cached context is then reused by the grouped-node map.
reference_selection <- traffic_map(
  day_standard,
  start_time = limits[1],
  end_time = limits[2],
  basemap = NULL,
  draw = FALSE
)
longitude_range <- range(reference_selection$nodes$longitude)
latitude_range <- range(reference_selection$nodes$latitude)
longitude_span <- max(diff(longitude_range), 1e-6)
latitude_span <- max(diff(latitude_range), 1e-6)
reference_bounds <- c(
  longitude_range[1] - 0.045 * longitude_span,
  longitude_range[2] + 0.045 * longitude_span,
  latitude_range[1] - 0.045 * latitude_span,
  latitude_range[2] + 0.045 * latitude_span
)
divvy_basemap <- if (params[["basemap"]]) {
  traffic_basemap(bounds = reference_bounds, offline = TRUE)
} else {
  NULL
}
options(bdynets.basemap.auto = FALSE)

# Same seven-colour green-to-red ramp and seven-row legend layout as the flow maps.
# OD counts are small integers, so the rows follow the integer count ladder
# (1, 2, ..., 6, >= 7) instead of the flow log1p grid, which would give
# fractional boundaries that no trip count can take.
od_palette <- c("#16a43a", "#7ad151", "#f7ea2a", "#ffc928",
                "#f5a623", "#f36b2b", "#f01818")
od_breaks <- 1:6
od_labels <- c(as.character(1:6), ">= 7")
```

### Station-to-station OD map

```{r od-map, fig.width=5.2, fig.height=8.4, out.width="72%", fig.alt="Station-to-station departures from midnight to 03:00 on January 1."}
map <- traffic_map(
  map_standard,
  start_time = limits[1],
  end_time = limits[2],
  bounds = map_bounds,
  basemap = divvy_basemap,
  od_style = list(
    flow_breaks = od_breaks,
    flow_labels = od_labels,
    flow_palette = od_palette
  ),
  title = "Divvy departures aggregated within 1.5 km",
  subtitle = paste(day, paste(window, collapse = " to "), timezone),
  caption = paste0(
    "Directed OD counts. Curved arrows do not identify travel paths.",
    if (params[["basemap"]]) "\nBackground: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)."
  )
)
```

```{r map-summary, echo=FALSE}
window_summary <- data.frame(
  Original_station_nodes = nrow(day_standard$nodes),
  Grouped_nodes_1_5_km = nrow(map_standard$nodes),
  Selected_trips = map$summary[["selected_flow"]],
  Within_group_trips = map$summary[["within_node_flow"]],
  Displayed_directed_pairs = map$summary[["displayed_pairs"]],
  Displayed_nonloop_trips = map$summary[["displayed_flow"]],
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(window_summary) <- c(
  "Original station nodes", "Grouped nodes (1.5 km)", "Selected trips",
  "Within-group trips", "Displayed directed pairs", "Displayed nonloop trips"
)
knitr::kable(window_summary, caption = "1.5 km grouped OD summary for 00:00 to 03:00", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

The half-open window `[00:00, 03:00)` contains `r map$summary$selected_flow` departures after the 1.5 km grouping, of which `r map$summary$within_node_flow` become within-group trips. The remaining `r map$summary$displayed_flow` nonloop trips are drawn across `r map$summary$displayed_pairs` directed group pairs. The grouping changes endpoints and the number of within-node trips, but not the selected trip total. The fixed seven classes remain `r paste(od_labels, collapse = ", ")`, with the green-to-red palette shown above. Curved arrows indicate direction between grouped endpoints rather than observed street routes.

## Validate the conversion

Validation is performed after the main workflow. The checks verify date filtering, agreement between the converted object and the prepared `input.rds` file, endpoint referential integrity, trip conservation across temporal and spatial aggregations, and source-file protection.

```{r validation, echo=FALSE}
validation <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "Date filtering retains 1,950 records on 2026-01-01",
    "Converted nodes and OD tables agree with the prepared day file",
    "Retained OD row count equals retained trips in provenance",
    "Ride IDs are nonblank and unique",
    "All OD endpoints exist in the station nodes table",
    "Hourly and spatial aggregations conserve total retained trips",
    "Spatial grouping does not reduce within-node trip totals",
    "The 1.5 km display aggregation conserves all retained trips",
    "The 1.5 km display aggregation reduces the node count",
    "Selected half-open window totals reconcile",
    "Source files remain unchanged during report generation"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    nrow(raw) == 1950L && ncol(raw) == 13L,
    isTRUE(all.equal(standard$nodes, full_input$nodes, check.attributes = FALSE)) &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(standard$od, full_input$od, check.attributes = FALSE)),
    nrow(full_input$od) == full_input$provenance$retained_trips && sum(full_input$od$flow) == full_input$provenance$retained_trips,
    !anyNA(full_input$od$ride_id) && all(nzchar(full_input$od$ride_id)) && !anyDuplicated(full_input$od$ride_id),
    all(full_input$od$origin_id %in% full_input$nodes$node_id) && all(full_input$od$destination_id %in% full_input$nodes$node_id),
    sum(hourly_input$od$flow) == sum(full_input$od$flow) && sum(spatial_input$od$flow) == sum(full_input$od$flow),
    sum(spatial_input$od$flow[spatial_input$od$origin_id == spatial_input$od$destination_id]) >= within_station_total,
    sum(map_standard$od$flow) == sum(day_standard$od$flow),
    nrow(map_standard$nodes) < nrow(day_standard$nodes),
    map$summary$selected_flow == map$summary$within_node_flow + map$summary$nonloop_flow,
    identical(source_before, tools::md5sum(source_files))
  )
)
knitr::kable(validation, caption = "Core validation results", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)

coverage <- data.frame(
  `Source departures` = full_input$provenance$source_departures,
  `Located stations` = nrow(full_input$nodes),
  `Retained trips` = nrow(full_input$od),
  `Within-station trips` = within_station_total,
  `Missing origin only` = full_input$provenance$missing_origin_only,
  `Missing destination only` = full_input$provenance$missing_destination_only,
  `Missing both endpoints` = full_input$provenance$missing_both,
  `Unmatched coordinates` = full_input$provenance$unmatched_coordinates,
  Unit = full_input$od_unit,
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(coverage, caption = "Complete-data coverage", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

<div class="result">Every validation row must be <code>TRUE</code>. The 1.5 km grouping preserves every trip but changes the display nodes and increases within-group trips. The map reports these loops separately because they have no directional arrow between distinct groups.</div>

## Export, read back, and reuse

`write_traffic_input()` publishes the teaching `standard` object to a new directory with RDS and CSV tables, a data dictionary, validation records, source identities, metadata, and checksums.

```{r prepared-export}
prepared_export_dir <- tempfile("divvy-prepared-export-")
dictionary <- read.csv("data/data-dictionary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dictionary_key <- paste(dictionary$table, dictionary$field, sep = "/")
standard_key <- c(
  paste("nodes", names(standard$nodes), sep = "/"),
  paste("od", names(standard$od), sep = "/")
)
dictionary <- dictionary[dictionary_key %in% standard_key, ]

prepared_path <- write_traffic_input(
  standard,
  prepared_export_dir,
  source_files = raw_file,
  native = raw,
  dictionary = dictionary
)
restored <- readRDS(prepared_path)
```

```{r prepared-export-checks, echo=FALSE}
metadata <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(prepared_export_dir, "metadata.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
exported_od <- read.csv(
  file.path(prepared_export_dir, "od.csv"),
  na.strings = metadata$csv$missing,
  colClasses = c(
    ride_id = "character",
    origin_id = "character",
    destination_id = "character"
  )
)
manifest <- read.csv(file.path(prepared_export_dir, "checksums.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
core_fields <- setdiff(names(standard), "provenance")
export_checks <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "RDS core fields read back unchanged",
    "CSV ride IDs, endpoints, times, and trip values read back correctly",
    "Dictionary and validation files are present",
    "Prepared-export checksums agree",
    "Source files remain unchanged"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    all(vapply(core_fields, function(key) identical(restored[[key]], standard[[key]]), logical(1))),
    identical(exported_od$ride_id, standard$od$ride_id) &&
      identical(exported_od$origin_id, standard$od$origin_id) &&
      identical(exported_od$destination_id, standard$od$destination_id) &&
      identical(as.numeric(exported_od$time), as.numeric(standard$od$time)) &&
      identical(as.numeric(exported_od$flow), as.numeric(standard$od$flow)),
    all(file.exists(file.path(prepared_export_dir, c("data-dictionary.csv", "validation.csv")))),
    identical(
      unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(prepared_export_dir, manifest$file))),
      manifest$md5
    ),
    identical(source_before, tools::md5sum(source_files))
  )
)
knitr::kable(data.frame(file = sort(list.files(prepared_export_dir))), caption = "Prepared-data export files", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(export_checks, caption = "Prepared-data readback checks", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(prepared_export_dir, "validation.csv")), caption = "Stored validation record", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

#### Derived-data export and readback {.unnumbered}

```{r derived-export-setup, echo=FALSE}
hourly_dictionary <- read.csv('data/data-dictionary.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[c('table', 'field', 'meaning')]
hourly_dictionary <- hourly_dictionary[vapply(seq_len(nrow(hourly_dictionary)), function(i) {
  table <- hourly_dictionary[["table"]][i]; field <- hourly_dictionary[["field"]][i]
  table %in% names(hourly_input) && is.data.frame(hourly_input[[table]]) && field %in% names(hourly_input[[table]])
}, logical(1)), ]
hourly_dictionary[["meaning"]][hourly_dictionary[["table"]] == 'od' & hourly_dictionary[["field"]] == 'time'] <-
  'Local hour interval start; the interval width and timezone are recorded in metadata.'
hourly_dictionary[["meaning"]][hourly_dictionary[["table"]] == 'od' & hourly_dictionary[["field"]] == 'flow'] <-
  'Retained trips for this hour and directed source station pair.'
spatial_dictionary <- data.frame(table = c(rep('nodes', 4), rep('od', 2)),
  field = c('display_name', 'raw_node_count', 'member_weight', 'endpoint_activity', 'time', 'flow'),
  meaning = c('Recorded name of the representative source station.', 'Number of source stations in this group.',
    'Sum of unit source-station weights; separate from trip counts.',
    'Departures plus arrivals at member stations; a within-node trip contributes two endpoints.',
    'Retained departure instant, with the source timezone recorded in metadata.',
    'Trips at this departure instant and grouped directed endpoint pair.'))

hourly_validation <- data.frame(
  check = c('Retained trips conserved', 'Unique hourly OD keys', 'Source station register preserved'),
  observed = c(sum(hourly_input[["od"]][["flow"]]), sum(duplicated(hourly_input[["od"]][c('time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id')])), nrow(hourly_input[["nodes"]])),
  expected = c(sum(standard[["od"]][["flow"]]), 0, nrow(standard[["nodes"]])),
  passed = c(sum(hourly_input[["od"]][["flow"]]) == sum(standard[["od"]][["flow"]]),
    !anyDuplicated(hourly_input[["od"]][c('time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id')]),
    identical(hourly_input[["nodes"]], standard[["nodes"]])),
  detail = c('The same retained departures are counted by local hour and directed station pair.',
    'Each hour and directed station pair occurs once.', 'Station fields and ordering remain unchanged.'))
spatial_validation <- data.frame(
  check = c('Retained trips conserved', 'Every source station assigned once', 'Representative radius bound', 'Time and grouped OD counts preserved'),
  observed = c(sum(spatial_input[["od"]][["flow"]]), nrow(spatial_membership), aggregation[["metadata"]][["max_assignment_distance_m"]], length(actual_spatial_counts)),
  expected = c(sum(standard[["od"]][["flow"]]), nrow(standard[["nodes"]]), aggregation_radius_m, length(expected_spatial_counts)),
  passed = c(sum(spatial_input[["od"]][["flow"]]) == sum(standard[["od"]][["flow"]]),
    !anyDuplicated(spatial_membership[["raw_node_id"]]) && setequal(spatial_membership[["raw_node_id"]], standard[["nodes"]][["node_id"]]),
    aggregation[["metadata"]][["max_assignment_distance_m"]] <= aggregation_radius_m + 1e-7,
    setequal(names(expected_spatial_counts), names(actual_spatial_counts)) &&
      all(expected_spatial_counts[names(actual_spatial_counts)] == actual_spatial_counts)),
  detail = c('Spatial grouping uses the same retained departures.',
    'Membership preserves every source station and its representative.',
    'Observed distance is no greater than the expected maximum, in metres.',
    'No departure time is binned; only identical time and grouped endpoints are summed.'))
```

```{r derived-export}
derivative_directory <- tempfile('divvy-derived-')
dir.create(derivative_directory)
hourly_path <- write_traffic_input(hourly_input, file.path(derivative_directory, 'hourly'),
  source_files = fixture_files, dictionary = hourly_dictionary, validation = hourly_validation)
spatial_path <- write_traffic_input(spatial_input, file.path(derivative_directory, 'spatial'),
  source_files = fixture_files, dictionary = spatial_dictionary, validation = spatial_validation)
membership_file <- file.path(derivative_directory, 'membership.csv')
write.csv(spatial_membership, membership_file, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r derived-readback, echo=FALSE}
derivative_checks <- data.frame(representation = character(), check = character(), passed = logical())
for (name in c('hourly', 'spatial')) {
  expected <- if (name == 'hourly') hourly_input else spatial_input
  path <- if (name == 'hourly') hourly_path else spatial_path
  restored_derivative <- readRDS(path)
  for (key in setdiff(names(expected), 'provenance')) stopifnot(identical(restored_derivative[[key]], expected[[key]]))
  for (key in names(expected$provenance)) stopifnot(identical(restored_derivative$provenance[[key]], expected$provenance[[key]]))
  derivative_metadata <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(dirname(path), 'metadata.json'), simplifyVector = TRUE)
  stopifnot(derivative_metadata$timezone == expected$timezone,
    derivative_metadata$od_unit == expected$od_unit,
    derivative_metadata$od_time_kind == expected$od_time_kind,
    identical(as.numeric(derivative_metadata$od_interval_seconds), as.numeric(expected$od_interval_seconds)))
  for (table in c('nodes', 'od')) {
    expected_table <- expected[[table]]
    classes <- vapply(expected_table, function(value) {
      if (inherits(value, 'POSIXct') || is.double(value)) 'numeric'
      else if (is.integer(value)) 'integer' else if (is.logical(value)) 'logical' else 'character'
    }, '')
    actual_table <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(file.path(dirname(path), paste0(table, '.csv')),
      colClasses = classes, na.strings = derivative_metadata$csv$missing, showProgress = FALSE, check.names = FALSE))
    stopifnot(identical(names(actual_table), names(expected_table)), nrow(actual_table) == nrow(expected_table))
    for (field in names(expected_table)) {
      a <- actual_table[[field]]; b <- expected_table[[field]]
      if (inherits(b, 'POSIXct') || is.numeric(b)) stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(a), as.numeric(b), tolerance = .Machine$double.eps)))
      else stopifnot(identical(a, b))
      stopifnot(identical(is.na(a), is.na(b)))
    }
  }
  manifest_derivative <- read.csv(file.path(dirname(path), 'checksums.csv'))
  stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(dirname(path), manifest_derivative$file))), manifest_derivative$md5))
  derivative_checks <- rbind(derivative_checks, data.frame(representation = name,
    check = c('Trip total retained', 'RDS and typed CSV readback', 'Export checksums'),
    passed = c(sum(expected$od$flow) == sum(standard$od$flow), TRUE, TRUE)))
}
restored_membership <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(membership_file,
  colClasses = c(raw_node_id = 'character', aggregate_node_id = 'character', distance_to_representative_m = 'numeric'),
  showProgress = FALSE))
stopifnot(identical(restored_membership, spatial_membership),
  identical(readRDS(spatial_path)$provenance$spatial_aggregation$membership, spatial_membership))
json_membership <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(dirname(spatial_path), 'metadata.json'), simplifyVector = TRUE)$provenance$spatial_aggregation$membership
stopifnot(identical(as.data.frame(json_membership), spatial_membership))
derivative_checks <- rbind(derivative_checks, data.frame(representation = 'spatial',
  check = c('Complete unique membership', 'Membership CSV and metadata readback'),
  passed = c(nrow(spatial_membership) == nrow(standard$nodes) && !anyDuplicated(spatial_membership$raw_node_id), TRUE)))
stopifnot(all(derivative_checks$passed), identical(source_before, tools::md5sum(source_files)))
knitr::kable(data.frame(representation = c('hourly', 'spatial'),
  data = c('hourly/input.rds', 'spatial/input.rds'),
  readable_tables = c('hourly/nodes.csv; hourly/od.csv', 'spatial/nodes.csv; spatial/od.csv; membership.csv'),
  timing = c('interval_start: 3600 seconds', 'original departure instants')),
  caption = 'Separate reusable derived outputs', format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(derivative_checks, caption = 'Derived-data validation and readback',
             format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
```



RDS readback preserves IDs, timestamps, values, timing metadata and membership exactly. Typed CSV readback checks the same table values and missingness. Each export also includes `data-dictionary.csv`, `validation.csv`, `metadata.json`, `source-files.csv` and `checksums.csv`. The membership CSV retains station IDs, group IDs and distances to representatives. Source files and the primary standard input are unchanged.

### OD-specific figure and window export

Road examples can use `traffic_export()`, but this example has no road-flow layer. The export below calls the unified `traffic_map()` on the OD standard object, writes PNG/PDF maps, and saves the selected routes, active nodes, summary, selection metadata, provenance, session information, and checksums.

```{r od-export-function}
export_od_window <- function(output_dir) {
  if (file.exists(output_dir)) stop("Choose a new OD export directory.")
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  result <- NULL
  for (extension in c("png", "pdf")) {
    current <- traffic_map(
      map_standard,
      start_time = limits[1],
      end_time = limits[2],
      bounds = map_bounds,
      basemap = divvy_basemap,
      od_style = list(
        flow_breaks = od_breaks,
        flow_labels = od_labels,
        flow_palette = od_palette
      ),
      title = "Divvy departures aggregated within 1.5 km",
      subtitle = paste(day, paste(window, collapse = " to "), timezone),
      caption = "Directed OD counts; curved arrows are not observed paths.",
      width = 5.2, height = 8.4,
      output_file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("od-map.", extension)),
      draw = FALSE
    )
    if (is.null(result)) result <- current
  }

  saveRDS(
    list(
      schema = "bdynets-od-window-v1",
      nodes = result$nodes,
      routes = result$routes,
      summary = result$summary,
      start_time = limits[1],
      end_time = limits[2],
      timezone = timezone,
      display_radius_m = map_radius_m,
      provenance = map_standard$provenance
    ),
    file.path(output_dir, "selected-window.rds"),
    compress = "xz"
  )
  write.csv(result$nodes, file.path(output_dir, "selected-nodes.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  write.csv(result$routes, file.path(output_dir, "selected-routes.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  jsonlite::write_json(
    list(
      schema = "bdynets-od-window-v1",
      selection = list(
        start_time = format(limits[1], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = timezone),
        end_time = format(limits[2], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = timezone),
        interval = "half-open [start, end)",
        timezone = timezone,
        loops_drawn = FALSE,
        display_radius_m = map_radius_m
      ),
      summary = result$summary,
      source = map_standard$provenance
    ),
    file.path(output_dir, "provenance.json"),
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    pretty = TRUE,
    null = "null",
    na = "null"
  )
  writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(output_dir, "session-info.txt"))
  files <- sort(list.files(output_dir))
  write.csv(
    data.frame(
      file = files,
      bytes = unname(file.info(file.path(output_dir, files))$size),
      md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(output_dir, files)))
    ),
    file.path(output_dir, "checksums.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  invisible(result)
}
```

```{r od-figure-export-checks, echo=FALSE}
figure_manifest <- read.csv(file.path(figure_export_dir, "checksums.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
figure_checks <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "PNG and PDF OD maps are present",
    "Selected routes, nodes, and provenance are present",
    "Exported OD totals equal the displayed window",
    "OD-window checksums agree"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    all(c("od-map.png", "od-map.pdf") %in% list.files(figure_export_dir)),
    all(c("selected-window.rds", "selected-routes.csv", "selected-nodes.csv", "provenance.json") %in% list.files(figure_export_dir)),
    exported_window$summary$selected_flow == map$summary$selected_flow &&
      exported_window$summary$within_node_flow == map$summary$within_node_flow,
    identical(
      unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(figure_export_dir, figure_manifest$file))),
      figure_manifest$md5
    )
  )
)
```

## Reproduction, source records, and troubleshooting

Place this Rmd in `examples/DivvyBike/`. From the repository root, render it offline with:

```bash
Rscript -e "source('bdynets/inst/preparation-session.R'); preparation_session('examples/DivvyBike'); rmarkdown::render('examples/DivvyBike/divvy-od-report.Rmd', knit_root_dir='examples/DivvyBike', params=list(basemap=FALSE, export=FALSE))"
```

`basemap=FALSE` requires no network. With `basemap=TRUE`, a verified cache may be reused; a new street-background request requires network access. OD nodes, routes, totals, validation, and exports do not depend on a basemap.

Common problems include a missing required column, duplicate ride IDs, an invalid or ambiguous local timestamp, an endpoint without a located station, a non-IANA timezone, a time bin that does not divide an hour, and reuse of an existing export directory. A missing OD row is not automatically an observed zero.

```{r reproducibility, echo=FALSE}
stopifnot(identical(source_before, tools::md5sum(source_files)))
knitr::kable(
  read.csv("data/original-sources.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[c("file", "provider", "role")],
  caption = "Original archive and source identity",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  read.csv("data/raw/source-manifest.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[c("file", "selection")],
  caption = "Bundled original-format excerpt and selection",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)
conversion_files <- intersect(c("prepare.R", "run.R"), list.files("."))
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    file = conversion_files,
    sha256 = vapply(conversion_files, digest::digest, "", file = TRUE, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
  ),
  caption = "Conversion and entry-point source identities",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)
bundle_dir <- file.path("..", "..", "bdynets")
bundle_files <- list.files(bundle_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = FALSE)
bundle_sha <- vapply(
  file.path(bundle_dir, bundle_files),
  digest::digest,
  "",
  file = TRUE,
  algo = "sha256",
  serialize = FALSE
)
revision <- digest::digest(
  paste(paste(bundle_files, bundle_sha, sep = " "), collapse = "\n"),
  algo = "sha256",
  serialize = FALSE
)

cat("Package version:", as.character(packageVersion("bdynets")), "\n")
cat("Bundled source revision (SHA-256):", revision, "\n")
cat("Report computation elapsed:", round(proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - render_started, 1), "seconds\n")
sessionInfo()
```
